twoFactor.title: Two-step verification (TOTP)
twoFactor.offBody: Add a second layer of protection: besides your password you need a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password...).

general.title: General settings
general.thresholdHint: The AI only auto-sends when confidence is at or above this value. Minimum 80%, default 85%.

general.keywordsHint: One word or phrase per line (up to 50, each ≤ 60 characters). AI replies containing any of them are not auto-sent.

productImport.title: Import products from Excel/CSV
productImport.subtitle: Upload a file, match columns, review errors, then confirm. Your product list only changes after you press Confirm.
productImport.limits: Supports .xlsx and .csv, up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows. Formula cells are never evaluated: paste values instead of formulas.
productImport.mappingHelp: Choose what each column in your file means. A Product name column is required. Use "Attribute" for color, size, etc.
productImport.errorsTitle: {count} errors (showing up to {shown}). Rows with errors are skipped on import.

rowErrors.PRICE_INVALID: invalid price (use a non-negative number, e.g. 150000 or 150.000)
rowErrors.STOCK_INVALID: invalid stock (use a non-negative whole number)
rowErrors.FORMULA_BLOCKED: cell contains a formula or starts with = + - @ and was blocked; paste the value instead
rowErrors.URL_INVALID: invalid link (only http:// or https:// are accepted)
rowErrors.DUPLICATE_VARIANT: same SKU or same attributes as a row above
